***Industry veteran to direct Investment Strategy across M&T Bank and Wilmington Trust***


BUFFALO, N.Y. and WILMINGTON, Del.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- M&T Bank Corp. (NYSE: MTB) announced that Brian Green has been named Chief Investment Officer for M&T Bank and Wilmington Trust effective today.


In this role, Green will lead the Asset Management team, which brings together economists, strategists, researchers and portfolio managers to deliver investment insights and solutions for both Wealth and Institutional clients. Green will set the investment philosophy and oversee strategies and delivery. He will report to Lisa Roberts, Head of Wealth Management at Wilmington Trust. Green succeeds Tony Roth, who will be retiring at the end of this year.


"Our clients are navigating increasingly complex investment needs in a dynamic market environment. Providing them with sophisticated advice and thoughtful investment strategies is critically important," said Roberts. "Brian has extensive experience developing tailored investment solutions for both individual and institutional clients. He is well-positioned to lead our Asset Management team and build on its strong foundation to help clients achieve their goals."


Green brings more than 30 years of experience across Investment Management and Private Wealth. Most recently, he served as Chief Investment Officer of Private Wealth at Glenmede Trust Co., where he was responsible for investment policy, asset allocation and portfolio construction. Earlier in his career, Green held investment roles at BNY Mellon and JPMorgan Chase, where his work included managing equity and multi-asset strategies and advising complex client relationships.


"The M&T and Wilmington Trust Asset Management team has built its reputation on the quality of its judgment, the rigor of its investment thesis and the consistency of its service to clients," said Green. "I am honored to join this group and look forward to extending that record and delivering the uncompromising level of insight and service that clients expect."


Green earned Master of Business Administration degrees from Columbia Business School and London Business School, as well as Bachelor of Science degrees in Accounting and Finance from the University of Arkansas. He is a CFA Charterholder.


**About Wilmington Trust**


Wilmington Trust is the Wealth Management and Investment Services arm of parent company, M&T Bank Corporation. Wilmington Trust Wealth Management offers personal trust, planning, fiduciary, asset management, private banking and family office services designed to help individuals and families grow, preserve and transfer wealth.


Wilmington Trust also provides Corporate and Institutional Services including corporate trust, agency and custody services to corporations, financial institutions and funds.
